area: Posts and publishing: statuses, missing posts, timeouts

entries.opening: Thanks for flagging this. Let's find out where the post went.

steps.text: "Published" means Blotato recorded a publishing result. On its own, that does not tell us why the post is missing from the feed.

cite.quote: Published means Blotato recorded a publishing result. It does not establish why the post is absent from a feed or why a platform URL is inaccessible.

steps.text: I checked your account: {evidence} If that is not the post you mean, tell me which one.
Open Posts > Published and confirm it went to the account or Page you meant.

cite.quote: Open Posts > Published and confirm the intended destination.

steps.text: Then check that same account or Page on the platform itself.

cite.quote: Check the same account or Page on the social platform.

steps.text: Please hold off on posting a replacement until we know what happened to this one.

cite.quote: Do not publish a replacement until the original result is understood.

entries.next: Check that account or Page on the platform itself, and tell me what you see there.
entries.proof: You will know it worked when you can open the post on the account it was meant for.

entries.title: Posts show CANCELED
phrasings: my posts show canceled in the calendar
why does my post say CANCELED
the post status changed to canceled, is it failing
several scheduled posts are marked cancelled
what does the canceled status mean on a post

not_this: how do I cancel my subscription
I canceled my plan
how do I cancel a scheduled post
how do I unschedule one post
entries.opening: Good news first: nothing is broken.

steps.text: CANCELED is not a failure. It is a status.

cite.quote: No. CANCELED is a post status, not a publishing failure.

steps.text: It means the schedule was removed before the post went out: deleted from the calendar, moved back to drafts, or removed through the API.

cite.quote: A post is marked canceled when its schedule was removed before it published

steps.text: Nothing went wrong on the social platform.

cite.quote: Nothing went wrong on the social platform.

steps.text: If you meant it to go out, open the post and schedule it again.

cite.quote: If you meant the post to go out, open it and schedule it again.

entries.next: Open the post and schedule it again if you still want it to go out.
entries.proof: You will know it worked when the post shows as scheduled again in your calendar.

entries.title: Status stuck on in-progress
phrasings: my submission has said in-progress for an hour
the post status is stuck on in-progress

not_this: my video is stuck generating
the AI agent is loading and makes no post

phrases: id came from the create response

entries.opening: Let's look at that id together. In-progress is a tricky status.

steps.text: I looked it up: {evidence}
In-progress can also mean Blotato found no record for that id, so it does not prove the post exists or failed.

cite.quote: If none matches, it returns in-progress. This fallback does not confirm a live queue job or validate a guessed submission ID.

steps.text: Please check that the id came from the original create response.

cite.quote: Verify the ID came from the original create response.

steps.text: A long wait is not proof it failed, so please do not post it again yet.

cite.quote: A polling deadline is not proof of failure.

steps.text: Failed posts are also listed at https://my.blotato.com/posts?status=failed, so please look there too.

cite.quote: Failed posts are also visible at <https://my.blotato.com/posts?status=failed>

entries.next: Send me the time you created it and the account, and I will check the post list.
entries.proof: Still open: whether this id belongs to a real post. The post list will tell us.

entries.title: Timeout after creating a post: send it again?
phrasings: my create post call timed out, should I send it again
504 gateway timeout when creating a post, did it post
the create post request timed out, is it safe to retry
a 502 when creating a post, will retrying make a duplicate
timeout from the API, do i resend the post
the publish request timed out, should I run the workflow again
not_this: my post is stuck in progress
too many requests error

steps.text: A timeout does not tell us whether the post was created, so please do not send it again yet.

cite.quote: The downstream operation's outcome is not established by this response.

steps.text: I checked your account: {evidence}
Check your scheduled, published and failed posts for it first.

cite.quote: Check existing work before submitting again

steps.text: Check the account on the platform itself, too. If Blotato shows a link to the post, open it.

cite.quote: Open any returned platform URL and check the intended account on the platform.

steps.text: If it shows as failed, fix the error first. Sending it again unchanged often fails the same way.

cite.quote: For a failed post, correct the error before a new submission. An unchanged retry often fails for the same reason.

entries.next: Look for the post in your scheduled, published and failed posts and on the platform itself, then tell me what you find.
entries.proof: You will know it is safe to send it again when the first post shows as failed, is not on the platform, and you have fixed its error.

entries.opening: Let's find out what happened to your post. Blotato and the platform each keep their own record, so it helps to look in both places.

steps.text: Open Posts and look for the post under Scheduled, Published and Failed, for the same account and content. If you do not find it, check the platform and time-window filters too.

cite.quote: Check the Scheduled, Published, and Failed filters in Posts for the same destination and content. Check the platform and time-window filters if a record is missing.

steps.text: Then check the account on the platform itself, for example your Instagram or TikTok page, to see if the post is there. If Blotato shows a link to the post, open it.

cite.quote: Open any returned platform URL and check the intended account on the platform.

steps.text: If the post is under Failed, open it and read the exact error before you change the media, reconnect the account, or try again.

cite.quote: Read the exact error before changing media, reconnecting an account, or retrying.

steps.text: Please do not post it again while we do not know what happened to the first one.

cite.quote: Do not submit a replacement while the original outcome is unknown.

steps.text: If the post shows no error, or you cannot tell whether it went out, write down the account, the Page or channel, what the post said, and the time it was meant to go out, with your time zone. Send that to us.

cite.quote: Record the intended social account, Page/channel, content, and submission or scheduled time with timezone.

entries.next: Look for the post in Posts > Failed and on the platform itself, then send us the exact error, or the details from step 5 if there is no error.
entries.proof: Still open: what happened to the post. The error on it, or what you find on the platform, tells us the right next step.
entries.note: For a failed post with no error text. With an error text or code in the message (symptom_only), this entry hands over, so that error's own entry or a person takes it.

anchors: where did my scheduled post go
/(didn.?t|did not|why did ?n.?t) (my |the |our )?(\w+ ){0,3}(go out|go up|go live|get posted|get published)/
entries.opening: Let's find out what happened to that post before anything else. A missing post does not tell us the cause on its own.

steps.text: Open Posts and check the Scheduled, Published and Failed lists for that account and that post. If you do not find it, check the platform and time-window filters too.

cite.quote: Check the Scheduled, Published, and Failed filters in Posts for the same destination and content. Check the platform and time-window filters if a record is missing.

steps.text: If Blotato shows a link to the post, open it and check the account on the platform.

cite.quote: Open any returned platform URL and check the intended account on the platform.

steps.text: If it is under Failed, read the exact error before you change anything or try again.

cite.quote: Read the exact error before changing media, reconnecting an account, or retrying.

steps.text: Please do not post a replacement until we know what happened to the first one.

cite.quote: Do not submit a replacement while the original outcome is unknown.

entries.next: Check Posts under Scheduled, Published and Failed for that post, and send us what you find, with the exact error if it shows one.
entries.proof: You will know it worked when you find the post in one of those three lists or on the platform itself.
entries.note: For a missing post with no error text and no known platform symptom. Neighbors: scheduled-posts-disappear-no-error (left Upcoming, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram), tiktok-post-disappears-buffering, published-not-visible.
